title: The stairs
goals: Do it in fewer than 5 lines.
starting_code:
# This reaches the top but bumps twice. Make it better.
wizard.move_up(3)
wizard.move_right(3)
wizard.move_up(3)
wizard.move_right(2)
hints: Press Run and watch where your wizard hits the wall.
Count the tiles for the upwards steps.
intro: This program climbs the stairs. But it bumps into the walls. Change the numbers so the wizard does not bump.
outro: Very smooth climbing! You are learning how to test and fix a program.
learned: Now you know that you can make a program better by trying it and changing its numbers, which programmers call arguments.
